Topology (b) (missed by the deriver) recomputed by the referee by hand: Wick parity +1 (ghost order a on Delta side), constants multiply to 1, numerator hat(k)^2 k^2 -> -2 eta (k^2)^2/d, N1 = -1/2 Theta^(b) P_c, Theta^(b) = -sum C_ad/2 wm wm; agrees with the checker's bmhvkit and explicit-matrix (d = 6..12) results; checker scripts rerun, outputs reproduced.
Vertex function from left derivatives: Gamma_{omega^a omega^c Rbar Psi} = -i kappa fg^(ace) Tg^e P_c for Gamma ⊃ kappa int Rbar wm wm P_c Psi.
N0 = 0 for all graphs with d-dimensional external momenta; consistent with b_d delta S^(1) = 0 in this class (equal pole coefficients C_ad/2 of Q_R^(fr) and Q_zeta[-1/2 fg_(r)] in g0_ghost_sources).
Diagram list agrees with ENUMERATION.md for all 22 source/fermion assignments and the 6 vanishing source functions.
